name: Righteous Vengeance procs off any direct critical strike with spells and abilities (#10355)
contract: Righteous Vengeance (rank 3, spell 53382) tooltip reads 'Direct critical strikes with spells and abilities make your target take additional damage... as Holy damage', unrestricted by ability. Its handler spell_pal_righteous_vengeance (src/server/scripts/Spells/spell_paladin.cpp) has no CheckProc override, so the restriction came entirely from the effective spell_proc row for SpellId=-53380 (data/sql/updates/db_world/2026_02_18_01.sql:84,1392), which carried SpellFamilyMask0=0x00800000 (Judgement) and SpellFamilyMask1=0x00028000 (Crusader Strike/Divine Storm), letting only those three abilities proc the DoT. Holy Shock's damage spell (25912, cast via the DUMMY-effect driver 20473) is also SpellFamilyName=10 but carries unrelated SpellFamilyFlags (0x200000, 0, 0x1000000) that overlap neither restricted mask word, so before the fix a critical Holy Shock never applied Righteous Vengeance Dot (61840). rev_20261101_01_righteous_vengeance_proc_scope.sql zeroes both FamilyMask columns for SpellId=-53380, keeping SpellFamilyName=10 (Paladin-family abilities only, per the proc row's own scoping) while removing the ability-specific restriction, so any direct critical Paladin-family hit -- including Holy Shock -- now procs the DoT.
